methodology.samplingUnit: fresh process launch; persistent extension state and OS caches retained
methodology.navigation: real loopback HTTP; 4 pages per launch
methodology.fixture: 1500 paragraphs, 400 CSS rules; 1 s settling; 90 animation frames with 50 mutations and forced layout; then 100 x 16 KiB no-store fetches
methodology.firstPageMs: prepare + surface creation + first didFinish; excludes catalog probes, process launch and Capacitor
methodology.summaries: median/min/max of per-launch metrics; warm page metrics reduce pages 1–3 to a median within each launch; no independent-page statistical claim
methodology.memory: UI process RSS only; excludes WebContent, extension and network processes
methodology.cpu: UI process CPU only, includes in-process fixture server and catalog probes; not energy or total extension CPU

New configuration
Category	Skip option	Seek bar color	Unsubmitted color
Sponsor			
Paid promotion, paid referrals and direct advertisements. Not for self-promotion or free shoutouts to causes/creators/websites/products they like. Learn More
Unpaid/Self Promotion			
Similar to "sponsor" except for unpaid or self promotion. This includes sections about merchandise, donations, or information about who they collaborated with. Learn More
Exclusive Access		
Only for labeling entire videos. Used when a video showcases a product, service or location that they've received free or subsidized access to. Learn More
Interaction Reminder (Subscribe)
